s1.text:
Blood on the walls. Not decorative — functional. The Feral marks its territory.

The air is thick with heat and the sound of something breathing. Deep, rhythmic, like a bellows. Whatever is ahead, it's big, and it's awake.

A narrow path leads through a bone-strewn canyon. A high ledge offers a vantage point. A collapsed tunnel smells of fresh air.
s1.imagePrompt: A blood-marked canyon entrance with bones scattered on the ground, thick heat haze, deep primal breathing echoing, three paths visible - narrow canyon, high ledge, collapsed tunnel, savage dark fantasy
s1.ascensionText: You've been here before. The blood on the walls is fresher now — the Feral has been hunting since you left.

choices.text: Take the narrow path — speed through the danger zone
Climb to the high ledge — observe from above

s2a.text:
From your vantage point, you see the Feral. It's pacing in a circle, faster with each lap. Its muscles ripple. Its eyes are wild.

This thing doesn't fight with strategy. It fights with escalation. Every round, it hits harder. Every round, it cares less about getting hurt.

The only way to win: end it fast, or be tougher than rage.
s2a.imagePrompt: A massive feral berserker pacing in circles with increasing speed, rippling muscles, wild unfocused eyes, viewed from above on a rocky ledge, primal aggression, dark fantasy

choices.text: Plan a first-strike blitz — maximum damage early
Prepare to absorb its rage — endurance wins
Your Berserker instincts read the Feral's attack rhythm

s2b.text:
The bones crunch under your feet. Something growls from the shadows — not the Feral, but something smaller. A warning: this territory is claimed.

You press on. The growling fades. Whatever it was decided you're not worth the fight.

That's more respect than the Feral will show you.
s2b.imagePrompt: Bones crunching underfoot in a dark canyon, glowing eyes watching from shadows, territorial markers on walls, tense predator territory, dark fantasy

choices.text: Move quietly — conserve energy for the real fight
Grab a bone — anything is a weapon

s2c.text:
The tunnel opens into a pit. The floor is sand, stained dark. This is where the Feral feeds.

Claw marks gouge the walls six feet deep. The sand is churned. Whatever happens here, it's violent and it's fast.

But in the chaos, you notice: the claw marks are always at the same height. The Feral doesn't vary its attack angle. It's powerful, but predictable.
s2c.imagePrompt: A sand pit with dark stains, deep claw marks gouging stone walls at consistent height, churned sand, evidence of brutal combat, a hunter's analysis, dark fantasy

choices.text: Duck low — fight beneath its attack line
Build your defenses — take the hits and hit back harder

s3.text:
The arena is raw earth. No walls. No ceiling. Just sky and dirt and the Feral, hunched at the far end, sniffing the air.

It sees you. Its eyes lock on. A low rumble builds in its chest.

There is no strategy here. Only survival.
s3.imagePrompt: An open-air earth arena under dark sky, raw dirt ground, a massive hunched feral berserker at the far end sniffing the air with locked predatory eyes, primal confrontation, dark fantasy

choices.text: Dodge and weave — speed beats power
Plant your feet — you will not be moved
Channel raw fury — match the beast blow for blow

s4_final.text:
The Feral doesn't speak. It roars — a sound that shakes the ground and loosens the stones beneath your feet.

Pain stopped mattering to it long ago. Now it's your turn to prove the same.
s4_final.imagePrompt: A massive feral berserker mid-roar, ground shaking, stones loosening, raw primal fury, muscles taut, savage boss encounter, epic dark fantasy
s4_final.ascensionText: The Feral stops mid-roar. It sniffs the air twice. It remembers your scent — and this time, it's angry about being beaten.
